name: graph_filters_read
description: GF-1a with GF-1b menu behavior: Filter: All is available without a file; a file written before opening the project offers its filters, and choosing one narrows the root canvas to the nodes it names. Editing the file's label and pressing Reload keeps the chosen id and takes the label; an invalid file says so, clears the choice and keeps Reload; an empty valid file returns to All and puts the hidden nodes back.
